name: BSP_GameSettings_GetLanguageName
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Direct callee of BSP_Application_Initialize (0073d410); analysis-only packet app_initialize_map, no reconstruction. Called at 0073e06a immediately before the localisation table load. Indexes DAT_00f88974 by this+4 with stride 0x20, returning field +4 or the fallback &DAT_00f88a3c. The language interpretation comes from the language, english, german, french, italian and spanish strings in 008d8190. Evidence: docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md; reports/app_initialize_map.json.

name: BSP_Settings_ApplyAudio
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = the settings object at 00f88980, no stack arguments. First call of BSP_Settings_ApplyAll (008d5b50) and also called from 005f42d0. Copies settings+24h to 00f8bbd8+70h, pushes settings+20h through 00a7a440, stores settings+28h/30h into 00f8bbcc+218h/21Ch, and routes the bus volumes through 00a7acf0/00a7f8e0 for the named buses Warnings, GUIMusic and GUITestSpeech. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_GAME_ENTRY.md.

name: BSP_Settings_ApplyAll
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Supersedes the provisional BSP_PostEffectSystem_Initialize from docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md: the body applies the whole settings object, not a post-effect system. __thiscall, ECX = the settings object at 00f88980, no stack arguments, RET. Ten call sites, eight of them in the options menu segment 23 (005efcf0, 005f0b90, 005f5ac0, 005f5e60, 005f65c0, 005f7c40, 005f8960) plus 004de610, 0067cfb0 and 0073e485. Applies audio through 008d5430, then gamma/brightness (00b1ffb0, virtual +F0h on 00f8d394), the four detail bytes at settings+41h..44h through 004b46e0, reloads Fonts\\ and the lockit tables for the language named by the 20h-stride table at 00f88974 indexed by settings+4, and reaches BSP_D3D9Renderer_ChangePresentationMode with settings+14h/18h/1Eh/58h/60h and XLiveOnResetDevice. The four blocks the decompiler removes as unreachable (008d5cf8, 008d5d34, 008d5db2, 008d5e64) are a memcpy of the literal Fonts\\ and three storage-pool string releases; no control flow is lost. Evidence: disassembly 008d5b50-008d5ef0; docs/APP_INIT_GAME_ENTRY.md.

name: BSP_GameSettings_Load
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet app_init_bootstrap_options, reconstructed except the renderer-caps tail; CORRECTS the earlier provisional name BSP_GameSettings_LoadFromRegistry. __fastcall void(cGameSettings*), RET 0; this is the static object at 00f88980 (MOV ECX,0xf88980 at 0073daa0). The primary source is an options TEXT FILE: 008d5150 builds the path from SHGetSpecialFolderPathA(CSIDL_PERSONAL), falling back to the global buffer at 00f88a3c, then fopen(path,rt). Tokens at 008d82e0-008d85ff: Language, Fullscreen(+0x1e), HiResShadow(+0x1d), NoLOD(+0x1c), Resolution(+0x14/+0x18, 640x480 fallback at 008d841f, index +0x78), VSync(+0x60), ShaderModel(+0x88), Antialias(+0x5c=0,+0x58), Clouds(+0x74), Foliage(+0x86), Shadow(+0x84 and +0x85), Reflection(+0x6c), TextureDetail(+0x68), ObjectDetail(+0x54), SoundEnabled(recognised then DISCARDED at 008d85d9), Firewall(+0x94), else 'Options: unknown token %s'. The registry key HKLM SOFTWARE\Eidos\Battlestations Pacific is read ONLY when fopen fails, for the single REG_DWORD value 'language' whose LCID maps 0x407 german, 0x40a spanish, 0x40c french, 0x410 italian, else english. The pseudocode else-chain is shifted by one because SoundEnabled has no handler; offsets are read from the listing. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_BOOTSTRAP.md; reports/app_init_bootstrap.json.
